fact: The eJustice.ci platform for online justice documents went live on 30 January 2025, described by the justice ministry's digital projects coordinator as an Ivorian solution designed and led by Ivorian engineers, with the ministry's own IT teams among the contributors.
title: Auger Cadet Séoulou : « En quatre jours, nous avons reçu environ 800 demandes de certificats de nationalité en ligne pour un taux de traitement dépassant les 70% »
